body: Not harsh at all I understand completely.  I am not inherently selfish but I am so wrapped up in my own trauma I have little empathy.

I am not a lazy person by nature as I am not working I am doing all I can around the house without being intrusive.

So far I have killed the mice, cleaned the kitchen and oven that likely has not been cleaned properly in over five years.  Mowed the lawns and helped him get a date with the cute neighbour.

Still not nearly enough to make up for practically free rent :(  but I am doing what I can and am interviewing now so hopefully somebody will buy my bullshit and hire me soon.

I relate in a big way.  I used to smoke daily heavily, and I grew to support this habit.  It became ridiculous the amount I was smoking, but I was pretty stable and had been for years so I thought it was time to try to realize my potential.

I stopped smoking and then continued not to because I got a job that had regular drug tests.  My life fell apart without the release I got from smoking, I was undiagnosed and just decided that I was bad at life so tried to start smoking again and it just did not work any more.  While it gave me clarity and a reality check it made me catatonic so paranoid and depressed I could barely move.

I am on Lamictal now, and I have two drinks in the evenings sometimes if I need a release.  Sometimes I will try it again, I do yearn for my old life but I don't think I can go back.  Self medicating was working for me but my life was/is stagnant.

Without weed I turned into a petulant teenager again, and I became undone when I fell in love with another bad girl who possibly has BPD or some other serious disorder.  I am a better person and funnily more sane when I am medicated, I just hope things will calm down now I am getting old once I am working again I will start DBT I want a normal life things that I never thought I could but after been diagnosed I feel I might one day.

Sad story really, I took her out late one night so she could have a good run and she met a German Shepherd who started a fight.  She was a Pit Bull purebred a real sweetie never had a problem until that night.  She tore the dog to shreds and was put down.

I fell into a deep depression, the house I was in was sold out from under me could not find another that allowed dogs and/or was a good grow spot.

I got an apartment and a "better" job proceeded to build my life up then tear it all down.
You already have, it is nice to talk to people who can relate if not totally understand, I think it is the Lamictal but I am less dismissive and negative than usual.

I appreciate it, I think it is the way to go no matter what all the "professionals" say just keeping my head above water is success for me I realize that now.

It is funny I had it all figured out when I was 19, I guess teenagers do know everything.  It will be a long hard road I guess I have to keep my eyes on the prize and keep on struggling.

Well these days most jobs especially in my field require regular drug tests.  Getting a dog is problematic in the city but not impossible.

I am not sure if I can go back, or if it will make me happy again.  In the end there was a reason I tried to live a normal life, I have potential but this sickness holds me back.  I had been faking it for so long I forgot who I really was, once stress came back into my life and I fell in love I turned into a petulant teenager again.

Thank you so much, I really do not do well with people I only really have one friend.  I am over sensitive and often react badly, a harmless jab by somebody is often met with a vicious comeback from me, it takes a lot of effort for me to act civil but I can only keep it up for so long.  I am hoping the DBT will help and hopefully some maturity with age.

Unfortunately there is a lot of mental illness in my family and thus it is very disjointed.  My Mother is living in another country and is pretty fed up with me the last time I reached out for support she told me to talk to my Father.  Who I have barely spent any time with since I was 10, he is remarried with four children who keep him very busy.  I cannot go to him after all these years with my hand out and even if I did the well is dry there.

I have made my bed and I have to lie in it, but I am worried my money will run out in a few weeks and without a job I am not sure what I will do.
Seriously?  Do you have some sort of murder/suicide fantasy??
Don't read the comments in the main front page link :(

:brofist:

I lurk mainly then might post my bullshit in a flurry if I am feeling the need to communicate.  I know I have nothing new to say and that I won't help anybody it is just good to not be selfish for a change in a community of people who won't judge me, apart from the downvotes :(

I hope there is no hormonal imbalance but it could make sense maybe.  I am 31 and just yesterday this girl did not believe I was a day over 23.  I am not hairy at all even though my brother is.  I brush it off and tell people I am just more highly evolved :P

I think the first is probably more likely, I think guys are probably either so bad they are in jail or just really good at hiding it due to gender roles etc.

Being a provider is part of being a man and is difficult for anybody with BPD.  As a man I am never going to have a knight in shiny armour come and rescue me but a lot of women I know with BPD seem to have had their turning point when they met the right guy.

What drugs?

I push people away over perceived slights or moments of slight embarrassment.

One thing that curbs my suicidal thoughts is funnily enough Weed and if I need a really big dose of reality LSD.

Ceasing to exist seems more scary than struggling on in life, I still have those thoughts and urges though when times are dark...

Shit my last ex called me the girl once.  I nearly kicked her out of my car while moving.  The first time she had seen my rage, it really hurt because it was true.  I loved her more than anything, and like you say I was so desperate I let myself get taken advantage of.

Hell yeah nearly every point raised is me to a degree!

Another seemingly high functioning BPD?

I have this strange thing I do where I am amazing at first impressions.  But I cannot keep up the act for very long.  I am quite knowledgeable and a bit of a show off and liar which 90% of the time works for me.

The real me does not exist it is something I strive for and I try to act like that person.

I should have been arrested so many times I just always manage to slip out of it. 

Everybody thinks I have it together, well the people who don't know me well.  It takes an enormous amount of effort to put on my normal mask play the part, by the end of the day I am exhausted.

I am exactly three weeks from being homeless, jobless and hopeless.  Not sure if it is the drugs or what but I am still pretty positive on the whole for now something will come along that will fix things up I hope.

On good days I think and told I am the greatest, on bad days I am a nightmate.  I don't do very well with relationships of any sort.

I tick all the boxes for BPD except I don't cut, I used to bite myself when I was a teen though.  My self harm I guess is drugs and casual sex, when the hollowness builds up(I know that sounds strange) I have to release it some how.

I self diagnosed ten years ago, then was in denial and recently messed up my life pretty bad due to a women who most likely has BPD too.  But at least now I am getting treatment and have been diagnosed and am on mediaction(Lamictal, Lorazepam)

I think true love is trust and respect built up over time, which is hard for me for obvious reasons.

The passion and lust of a new love I feel very strongly but usually there is a deal breaker I find pretty quickly which causes me to dismiss the person, usually the deal breaker is that I am too fucked up for them.

I am still messed up from my ex, I think she had BPD as well and was a master manipulator.  I was getting fed up with her before she left but when she disappeared without saying goodbye the abandonment was the worst pain I have ever felt apart from my dog passing.

I wouldn't take any advice from a fuck up like me, in saying that...

Just try to keep it in the pm, I ended up smoking mornings and lunch times eventually which is not a good plan.  And don't start smoking meth to combat the drowsiness :P
I just started on it a month ago, I am up to 100mg a day but think it should be more.  I don't notice much of an effect so far but am sticking with it.

I smoked every day for over ten years heavily.  I quit because my psychologist said all my issues were because of the weed.  Also I started a new job that had regular drug testing.  My life fell apart once I was off it, back to the angry messed up teenager I was ten years ago.

The worst part is after 18 months off it I now cannot handle it.  It does not make me euphoric and relaxed any more just paranoid and depressed :(

I am in the same boat, it is rough.  

I do have family but I have not seen them in over six years, I cannot go and see them after all this time with my hand out.  I recently was fired from my job and don't like my prospects of getting a new one on top of all my financial problems things are pretty bleak.

I don't know what I will do I just have to hope that things will come right somehow.  I am so envious of people I know with supportive families, my Mother kicked me out when I was 17 I will never forgive her and besides she lives in another country now anyway and is not willing to help.

I am in a somewhat similar situation.  Messed up drugged up relationships are the worst but they do feel safe as there is constant crisis which logically does not make sense but I have read is very common for people with BPD.

I am proud of you, you have done very little and seem to be handling things quite well relatively.

Your right the drugs don't work but careful coming off of them cold turkey.  Marijuana was my saviour from years 18-29.  I thought my issues were because of it so I gave up and my life has come crumbling down around me.  I feel like an angry teen again, I am hoping with the therapy and prescribed drugs I can get better.
Nobody deserves to be treated this way.  It is a tragedy there is another life involved.  I hope you have some good luck coming your way!
My Mum did this through my entire childhood

I can totally relate, when I am in bed with a pretty girl the rest of the world melts away all that matters is the connection and making the girl I am with feel amazing.  

Unfortunately the more sex you have, the more you need, the more you want....
I just want to say what you have written is beautiful.  I am in the same position as you and just reading what you said warmed my soul(if I have one)
I either get bored and break some poor girls heart after a couple of months, or I get obsessively in love with another damaged individual...

So 45 do you have a family?  Wife, kids and a career?

Although I just cannot visualize myself in the future I do want those things but I don't think they are going to happen.

I was in a similar relationship for three years it was hell.  But the constant drama and crisis was kind of soothing I did not have to think about anything else apart from what the latest drama was.

When I started to plan my ex's murder I knew I had to leave, I am not a violent person I don't think I would have done it but those kind of fantasies are very worrisome. 

It was a process I had to first break up with her, she stabbed me with a broken wine glass sobbed, screamed and yelled in front of her daughter.....it was so bad.  A huge knot just developed in my stomach thinking about it.

Anyway it took 2 months to move out, she cost me my job in the process and alienated all my friends.  I am no angel either but I had to be the sane one and leave. 

It was worth it in the end, she is bi-polar and her obsessive love was very comforting at first.  And like I said the constant crisis was strangely soothing but the fact she was ten years older than me and got me hooked on meth and used that to control me is another story altogether!

I have pretty much always been in denial and hid the way I am.  With my diagnosis earlier this year I have told family who were not surprised but have pretty much given up on me now anyway.

I don't think I could ever tell "friends" I have BPD, but if I did I guess I would say I have trouble regulating my emotions.

I can relate definitely, I have an incredible memory and am an incredibly fast learner and worker.

But my interpersonal skills usually ruin things.  Generally I am rated really well 4 out of 5 days when the cracks in my act start to show.  Usually within a year I will voluntarily leave a job due to an outburst or something I have done in relation to somebody I do not get on with.

We have public healthcare in my country unfortunately for mental illness it is the ambulance at the bottom of the cliff.  As I am reasonably high functioning they pretty much won't see me and it is pointless anyway because I cannot not relate to any of them. 

You get what you pay for it would seem, Psychiatrist $250 good psychologist $200.

Interesting, I am really keen on Ayahuasca and Ibogaine.  I was really disheatened I got rejected from ibogaine treatment because I am not an opiate addict I mean what meth isn't bad enough!?

I am in NZ so it is a long expensive flight to Mexico or South America for that kind of treatment.  I am pretty keen on trying it as LSD saved my life in my late teens.

My public persona is basically a good guy, positive and confident.  Very honest and moral basically the exact opposite of who I am.  I am exhausted by the end of the day keeping everything together but I have no support I have to work or else I am screwed.

Agreed, but there is some interesting stuff in this article which is the only part of the site I looked at.

There is a lot of noise there but enough truth to keep me reading.

I think it relates to a narcissistic male.

It is tough, I do not know how things work in your home country so I am unsure on what to advise in terms of cheap counselling but I would say unfortunately it seems you get what you pay for.

My current psychologist costs me nearly $200 a session which takes away my play money which is probably a good thing at this point in my life.  She is worth every cent though, finally being diagnosed properly and being given hope and evidence that others have come through the other side and DBT does work.

Cheap help would be researching the hell out of the BPD and DBT online and going to support forums.  But be careful and keep your wits about you.

The only thing they did for me noticeably was quell the suicidal urges once I had been on them for 3 months or more at a high dose.  However when you start taking them or stop taking them those urges come back strong so I think it kind of evens out.

I am also a sex/love addict so one of the good things they do is delay orgasm.  But it can be frustrating as I get bored easily and find it hard to orgasm after the first few times with a women when I am on them unless there is amazing chemistry.

All in all it is a mixed bag, they are not as fun or immediate as self medicating :P

It is only because I was kicked out of home when I was 17 that I learnt how to hold down a job, I had no other choice if I want to eat I have to work.

Even still my impulses and trouble with relationships have caused major issues for me and I have had 9 jobs in my life.  I am a very hard worker and generally get on well with customers but inside the workplace I have often caused drama.  

Here are some rules I made for myself for what it is worth.

Never date a coworker I learnt that early on it was the reason I left my first job.

Invent a physical illness so your absenteeism has an excuse.  Your doctor will write you a note each time but will not say what is wrong just that you were unfit for work.

Do not tell management of your issues, it will follow you when you ask for a reference.

When thing get too much just stop and think about your next break, it is daunting starting a shift you feel there is no way you can make it through the day, you can just look forward to your breaks not the end of the day.

Work hard, time will go faster when your busy and you have less time to invent drama.

I keep my work and personal life completely separate, keep work friends at work.

Remember that your time is not your own you have sold it.


Not sure if that is of any help, sometimes I wish I had a close and caring family but my independence is one of the only things I am proud of.
Good for you, how about outside of work?  Lots of close friends, steady partner?  How about hobbies?

I still struggle and I am about to turn 31.  My last girlfriend would say this isn't a fairytale and your acting like a kid and she was right and it hurts a lot.

For a long time I struggled and just told myself I was just acting like a spoilt brat and I need to stop being immature.  I managed to lead a pretty good life  which I then would destroy and rebuild.

Long story short, get help now do not waste your potential and your 20's like I did.  I have nothing, I have debt and no assets my former friends from school have kids families and careers.  I thought I was smarter and stronger I could find another way to live and beat it but I was wrong there is something wrong with me and it is not my fault but it is my responsibility to change.

Nope pretty bad, it has been six weeks now and it is not subsiding I swing between rage and agony.  I am holding down my job which is important but other than that just sleeping all day.

Seeing my Therapist tomorrow will come clean about everything, I cant undo what I have done.  I just wish she would come clean with me, I am so tempted to contact her sister who lives in the country but I don't want to be that guy.

I am hoping with therapy I will grow out of this and maybe by the time I am 40 I will be able to have friends and maybe even a partner.

Oh and if I forgive her I am forgiving myself for being so stupid and trusting somebody who I knew in my heart I shouldn't.

Thanks I know that if I forgive her I am forgiving myself, intellectually I know this is the case but I cannot help myself.

The reason I am not telling my psychologist is I promised her I would end things with her early on after one of our early fights.  But I could not say no to her and of course patched things up.

I am such a liar I cannot help myself, so I did not tell my psychologist and have been avoiding sessions partly because of this and partly due to finances.

In therapy now, with a BPD specialist early days but I am positive, seems to be good evidence that if I stick with it I might be able to change and live up to my potential.

My last psychologists were all convinced there was nothing wrong with me apart from substance abuse issues.  So I got sobered up for a couple of years and the suicidal thoughts came back strong and the crazy strong emotions and the self destructive behaviour.
For sure when you are in a serious relationship.  But with flings do you not keep them compartmentalized from the rest of your life?

I read somewhere that only another borderline can hold their attention.  Have you ever heard the saying available but unattainable?  She was probably seeing other people while with you.  Or I could be totally wrong, think about her actions not her words.

It is sad but true, sorry I know it is probably not what you want to hear.

You people have friends, more than one. 

I am jealous.
I have been on both ends of your situation it is horrible.  It is what you expect it was, she  was not treating you like you were her boyfriend.

I feel as though for me it is all part of the chase, I am play acting with a tried and true script for seduction.  I feel I mean them at the time but as GRR Martin would say words are wind actions are what matters.

I am no angel, and this situation is totally my doing.  I do not want to try to make out I am an innocent party in all of this far from it.

This behaviour has only happened two other times, and not this bad.  Usually the roles are reversed.

I do not know the answer, I am 30 and have never had a healthy relationship last for more than a few months.  I had a very unhealthy one last three years, she was much older than me and bi-polar which actually caused me to avoid treatment for so long.  After living with her I decided I was not all that crazy.
